## Automated Tests Required

### S6-04 — chapter 1 error/restart path (Integration)

**Test file path**: `Assets/GameScripts/HotFix/GameLogic/DevTest/Spikes/S6-04_ErrorRestart.cs`（1 file + 3 inner class per S5-1b/-1c/-02/-08 precedent）

**Evidence doc**: `production/qa/playmode-error-restart-2026-05-XX.md`（per S5-02 precedent ~280 lines）

**What to test** (4-5 R3 PlayMode probe case, per Sprint 6 plan S6-04 AC)：
- **P1 UnknownChapterButtonClick**: chapter id 99 / -1 / null → SceneManager.OnRequestSceneChange handler → `TryResolveOrFail` → 不进 Error，保持 Idle 解锁状态（contrast Sprint 5 chapter 0 spec drift behavior 已 documented per V3.0 §V3-1.c dp6）；assert `state == Idle` after fail attempt
- **P2 MidTransitionCancel**: chapter 1 transition 中点 Quit/restart Button click → unload 干净；assert `CurrentLoadedChapterId == NoChapterId(-1)` + `state == Idle` + 0 leaked GameObjects
- **P3 AssetLoadFail**: fixture chapter id 6 sceneName 不存在 → asset load fail → state=Error + restart 路径 available；assert `state == Error` + `LastErrorReason != null` + restart button clickable
- **P4 RestartFromErrorState**: Error 状态后点 main menu / restart Button → state machine reset 干净；assert `state == Idle` after restart sequence + `CurrentLoadedChapterId == NoChapterId(-1)`
- **P5 RepeatedRapidOnRequestSceneChange (race)**: 2-3 个 rapid OnRequestSceneChange(1)(2)(1) 派发 → debounce 验证；assert 仅 first request 处理，subsequent 被 ignore OR state machine 安全降级；assert no race-induced state corruption

**Edge cases to cover**：
- Zero/minimum: chapter id 0（已 documented per V3.0 §V3-1.c chapter 0 spec drift；reuse S5-02 fix path = 不支持，TryResolveOrFail）
- Maximum/boundary: chapter id 6+ (out of [1, 5] documented range; fixture 缺) → asset load fail path
- Invalid/null: OnRequestSceneChange(int.MinValue) / OnRequestSceneChange(int.MaxValue)
- Race: 同 P5 + concurrent OnSceneTransitionBegin 派发后 spike subscribe 时机（per V3.0 Type-6 candidate）

**Estimated test count**: ~4-5 R3 cases / ~20-25 asserts (per Sprint 5 平均 5-7 asserts/case)

**M1 dual-layer reflection**: 全 production reflection (`GameApp._sceneManager` instance + `SceneManager.CurrentLoadedChapterId` + `SceneManager.LastErrorReason`) per S5-1c/-02 precedent

### S6-08 — ui-system-008 popup queue + inputblocker robust (Integration + UI)

**Test file path**: `Assets/GameScripts/HotFix/GameLogic/DevTest/Spikes/S6-08_UILayerStrategy.cs`（1 file + 3 inner class）

**Evidence doc**: `production/qa/playmode-popup-inputblocker-2026-05-XX.md`

**What to test** (5 R3 PlayMode probe TC, per Sprint 6 plan S6-08 AC = ui-system-008 story 9 AC)：
- **P1 PopupQueueOrder**: enqueue popup A → enqueue popup B → enqueue popup C → assert order = [A, B, C] + only A visible (head of queue) + B/C blocked / queued state；dequeue A → assert B visible + queue = [B, C]
- **P2 AutoDequeueOnClose**: popup A close → auto-dequeue → next popup B 自动 show；assert dequeue 触发 close → next-show 序列 + no manual dequeue call needed
- **P3 AutoInputBlocker**: show popup → assert UIRoot under-blocker GameObject active + raycast blocked for under-popup elements；close popup → assert blocker deactivate
- **P4 OverlayLimit**: enqueue 4 个 overlay (limit = 3) → assert 第 4 个 rejected / queued with overlay limit warning；overlay 0 close → 4th 自动 dequeue 进 overlay 槽
- **P5 DualInputBlockerStacking**: show popup A (with blocker 1) → show popup B on top (with blocker 2) → assert 2 blockers stacked + only top-most visible + raycast 双层 block；close B → blocker 2 lift + blocker 1 still active → close A → all blockers lift

**Edge cases to cover**：
- Queue overflow: enqueue >10 popups → assert overflow protection (drop oldest / reject newest per design)
- Nested popup from popup: popup A spawns popup B in OnRefresh → assert nesting via queue (not via overlay) per design
- Rapid show/close cycle: 5 cycles in 1s → assert no state leak + no orphan blockers
- Vendor TEngine UIModule integration: verify Popup queue 不与 vendor _uiStack 冲突（per S5-08 R2.7 precedent）

**Estimated test count**: ~5 R3 cases / ~30-35 asserts (popup queue 复杂度较高)

## Smoke Test Scope

Critical paths to verify before any Sprint 6 implementation hand-off (per `/smoke-check sprint` skill)：

1. **Game launches to main menu without crash** — Unity Editor PlayMode 启动 → splash → main menu UIWindow 显示 (per S6-07 post-fix baseline)
2. **New Game button click → chapter 1 transition complete** — ISceneEvent.OnRequestSceneChange(1) → DriveTransitionAsync 11-step → chapter 1 active (per Sprint 5 S5-02 baseline 5/5 R3 PASS)
3. **chapter 1 fun loop happy path** — Object interaction → shadow match → puzzle complete → narrative beat → audio duck → Next Chapter click → chapter 2 (placeholder) transition (per Sprint 5 S5-02 baseline)
4. **chapter 1 error path graceful degradation** — Sprint 6 S6-04 实施后 newly added critical path：unknown chapter id / mid-transition cancel / asset load fail → Idle 解锁 OR Error state restart 可达
5. **UI infrastructure robustness** — Sprint 6 S6-07/-08 实施后 newly added：main menu UIWindow 7 lifecycle + popup queue + inputblocker stacking 无 race
6. **Save / load cycle**: N/A Sprint 6（Settings descope, save system 留 polish phase）
7. **Performance**: chapter 1 PlayMode total time ≤ 10s (per Sprint 5 S5-02 baseline 3844ms; Sprint 6 不允许 regression > +50%)

*Smoke tests are verified by the developer via `/smoke-check sprint` after S6-01 playtest 1 readiness baseline. Reference this list when running that skill.*

## Definition of Done — Sprint 6

A story is DONE when ALL of the following are true:

- [ ] All acceptance criteria verified — via automated test result (R3 PlayMode probe PASS for Integration stories) OR documented manual evidence (screenshot/video for Visual/Feel；playtest notes with sign-off for Playtest；git diff readback for Config/Data + Governance)
- [ ] Test file exists at the specified path for all Integration stories (S6-04/-07/-08)
- [ ] Manual evidence document exists for all Playtest/Visual/Feel/Governance stories (S6-01/-02/-03 playtest docs + S6-09 screenshot doc + S6-10 gate-check verdict doc)
- [ ] ADR amend stories (S6-05/-06) — git diff readback + R2 grep verify pass + commit message 引 V3.0 §V3-1.b propagation
- [ ] **Smoke check passes** — run `/smoke-check sprint` after S6-01 playtest 1 readiness baseline + after S6-04/-07/-08 done + before S6-10 gate-check
- [ ] No regressions introduced — Sprint 5 chapter 1 happy path 5/5 R3 baseline 必须保持 PASS (re-run S5-02 R3 probe after Sprint 6 critical path changes)
